messages:
Asha (GTM): quick follow from today's all-hands re: partner-led pipeline. Need clarifications for exec follow-up.
Maya (Sales): ready. what are the asks?
Asha (GTM): 1) split of net-new pipeline this qtr by source (partner vs direct). ballpark %s good.
Jules (RevOps): partner-influenced ~32% of net-new pipeline value. verified with CRM tag rollup.
Diego (Partnerships): we're tracking ~9 partner-led opps > $75k; 2 are closing this quarter.
Maya (Sales): note: one of those moved from partner referral -> AE-engaged in 48h, that flow looks healthy.
Asha (GTM): 2) routing: are partner leads hitting SDR queue or routed to AEs? current pain points?
Diego (Partnerships): default is SDR. problem is manual reassignments delay time-to-first-touch.
Jules (RevOps): we can add a CRM rule: if referral score >= 8 and ARR est >50k -> AE direct. low-effort change.
Maya (Sales): please include fallback if AE calendar full (auto-assign to designated SDR).
Diego (Partnerships): will include fallback rules in the doc.
Asha (GTM): 3) attribution & telemetry: leadership wants partner attribution in weekly ops reports and in hosted-usage exports.
Nina (Product): product has an attribution header available at the SDK layer but it's not persisted into the usage export. scope: persist header into export pipeline + tag in analytics.
Jules (RevOps): estimate for turning on export field?
Nina (Product): engineering: 1 sprint to persist, 1 sprint for QA and analytics wiring. low priority but small.
Asha (GTM): can you mark this as medium priority? exec wants it for next partner review.
Nina (Product): will queue it as medium and notify when scheduled.
Asha (GTM): 4) metrics to track weekly for partner health suggestions?
Priya (CEO): partner-influenced pipeline velocity, referral->SQL conversion, and partner-sourced churn risk signal.
Jules (RevOps): add "median time-to-first-activity" and average deal size for partner-sourced deals.
Diego (Partnerships): I'll prototype a mock dashboard and drop screenshots in #partners.
Asha (GTM): 5) partner enablement ask: leadership wants a single-slide readiness check for partner pilots. key bullets?
Maya (Sales): must include legal status, integration readiness, comms plan, POC timeline.
Sam (Legal): for pilots, I need partner contact, data handling summary, and SOC2 checklist status. will expedite if labeled "pilot-fasttrack".
Diego (Partnerships): noted. I'll assemble the slide and tag Legal + Sales.
Asha (GTM): action items: Diego -> partner routing + slide draft (due Tue EOD). Jules -> add attribution field to dashboard once product ships. Nina -> scope & schedule export change. Sam -> prep SOC2 pilot checklist pipeline. Maya -> update playbook with AE fallback.
Diego (Partnerships): creating a shared folder for artifacts and will add template emails for partner intros.
Jules (RevOps): will add a dashboard card for "partner time-to-first-touch" and surface it in the weekly ops email.
ops-bot: Reminder created: Weekly partner health summary -> #partners every Monday 8:30am PT.
Asha (GTM): thanks everyone. I'll compile a 1-slide summary and send to Priya before Friday's exec sync.
Priya (CEO): thanks team 44d
Maya (Sales): thumbs up, moving to action.
